chunks: What the Shaykh — may Allah the Exalted aid him — informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from 'Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
One day I performed wudu but did not wash my penis. Then I prayed. Then I remembered, so I asked Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), and he said: «Wash your penis and repeat your salat.»
Thus he made obligatory the repetition of the salat and the washing of the place, as we have mentioned.

key_terms.اَلْمَوْضِعِ: the place, the specific body part in question
key_terms.ذَكَرِي: my penis (private part requiring purification after urination)

ai.seo_question: What is the Shia jurisprudential ruling if one performs salat after wudu without washing the penis?
ai.summary: Zurarah narrates that one day he performed wudu but omitted washing his penis, then proceeded to pray. Upon remembering, he asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS), who ruled that he must wash the private part and repeat the salat. Al-Shaykh al-Tusi appends his own jurisprudential conclusion affirming both obligations, situating this hadith within the chapter on ritual impurities that necessitate purification.
